description: This file defines the UriComposer class, which implements IUriComposer interface. It is responsible for composing URIs for product pictures based on catalog settings, specifically replacing a placeholder in URI templates with the actual catalog base URL.

classes.name: UriComposer
classes.description: Implements IUriComposer to generate complete picture URIs by replacing placeholders in URI templates.

methods.name: ComposePicUri
methods.description: Replaces the placeholder URL in the input template with the catalog's base URL to generate a full URI.
